preregistration.admission: Run only if the earlier stack qualifies at its registered threshold; keep its results and inference separate. No current-stack outcomes were consulted when choosing order, sample size or fixture.
preregistration.failure: If an input, source equivalence, changed-mode behavior, diagnostic, exact A/A, byte-level loader, native integrity, or resource gate fails, preserve it and withhold the affected result. Maintain 25GiB home and 10GiB measurement-tmpfs reserves; no competing native jobs.
preregistration.functional: Run ordinary untimed and physically traced reversals/restorations before and after scoring. Verify counts of genuine full and link-only rustc, Wild and the three real scripts, all 520 artifacts, unchanged warnings and script/metadata evidence. Establish that the changed script still executes, a true directive or external included file still changes native output or fails like a clean build, and the second historical Pydantic generation produces the correct ZIP member on each current arm. The historically observed 3→0 repeated check may be neutral or absent on this new stack; retain such an outcome and do not publish a current-stack improvement if it fails the checks.
preregistration.independence: 24 new pairs ordered by a distinct frozen seed. A private current-compiler target/shared/registry lineage, separate immutable four source/arm starting snapshots and fresh per-episode copies. Require each state and episode to pass real 520-fresh preflight. Do not share issued episodes or measured ms with the earlier study. Initial seeds may reuse immutable dependency bytes through separate copies, but must build/check against the current compiler/runtime and be verified with real processes. No mtime interventions. Restore the authentic linked checkout after each private source view.
preregistration.inference: For each pair and three endpoints (changed, first untouched, their sum), log(C/P), then 100*(1-exp(mean)) reduction. Compute two-sided exact randomization conditional on six C-first per direction across the 924×924 assignments. Holm .05 across these three, direction-stratified percentile bootstrap 100000 samples with seed 278432. Claim speedup only if Holm-adjusted p<.05 and the full 95% reduction interval is positive. Both per-direction rows and second untouched descriptive measurements retained. No inference pooled with the earlier cohort.
preregistration.real_ruff_edit: a8ba9e0458e60f8c406216778f0ea1cc3759c9b2, full linked Git watch fix reversed and restored, three complete build.rs files
preregistration.seed_domain: Ohm release 1.99.0-16 independent current-stack historical build-script timestamp confirmation; 4c07cbf6; 2026-10-27.
preregistration.source_and_release: Build matched release-profile PGO control and treatment from same verified full input manifest and same compiler/SDK/profile. Require a second independent byte-identical parent. Use only the already-validated Ohm SDK LLVM packaging with whole ELF/loader/RELRO guards, or directly identical raw release outputs if their regular production packaging supplies A/A exactness. Publish immutable recipe, packaging choice and all actual source/compiler/Cargo/LLVM SHAs before timing. Run an unmodified -16 packaged stock physical calibration once its official archive digest is authenticated. In addition, require raw-versus-packaged source-build rosters to match if packaged images are the scored subjects.
preregistration.title: Conditional prospective independent whole cargo check confirmation on shipped Cargo source 1.99.0-16
preregistration.treatment: Apply exactly the same two hunks in source-delta.patch, including its new checked-in unit regression, to upstream_cargo_git. Publish resulting Git commit and tree proofs before scoring. Both touched function bodies were identical between the calibrated earlier parent and -16 on preregistration.
preregistration.trial: 12 reverse and 12 restore randomized paired episodes, six parent-first per direction. Each arm times one full changed check, its first untouched check, and its second untouched check. 144 ordinary, untraced commands. Native lock, CPU 0–23/-j8, same logical paths, normal exit and stdout/stderr included in the monotonic clock. No tracing, checksum analysis, or command setup between the starts except ordinary file opening and process dispatch. Exclude copying/namespace startup. Record all admissions and failures.
